title.en: Chapter 15 — Tom Goes Home in the Dark

sentences.ar: النهر بين الجزيرة والقرية مش عريض، بس التيار قوي.
sentences.en: The river between the island and the village is not wide, but the current is strong.

sentences.ar: مشى توم بالمي لحد الخصر، وبعدين سبح.
sentences.en: Tom walked in the water up to his waist, and then swam.

sentences.ar: والتيار أخده لتحت، بس هو كان سباح منيح.
sentences.en: And the current took him downstream, but he was a good swimmer.

sentences.ar: وصل عالشط التاني بعيد عن القرية، ومشى عالطريق، بالعتمة.
sentences.en: He reached the far bank away from the village, and walked along the road, in the dark.

sentences.ar: وكان في باخرة مربوطة، فركب فيها، ونام بالقاع لحد ما تحركت.
sentences.en: And there was a ferry tied up, so he got on it, and lay in the bottom until it moved.

sentences.ar: ولما وصلت للقرية، نزل، وركض بين البيوت.
sentences.en: And when it reached the village, he got off, and ran between the houses.

sentences.ar: وصل لبيت الخالة بولي، وشاف ضو بالشباك.
sentences.en: He reached Aunt Polly's house, and saw a light in the window.

sentences.ar: طل من الشباك: الخالة بولي قاعدة، وسيد، وماري، وأم جو هاربر.
sentences.en: He looked through the window: Aunt Polly sitting, and Sid, and Mary, and Joe Harper's mother.

sentences.ar: وكلهم بيبكوا.
sentences.en: And all of them crying.

sentences.ar: دخل من الباب الخلفي، وزحف تحت السرير، وسمع.
sentences.en: He went in the back door, crawled under the bed, and listened.

sentences.ar: كانت الخالة بولي بتقول: توم ما كان ولد سيء.
sentences.en: Aunt Polly was saying: Tom was not a bad boy.

sentences.ar: كان شقي بس.
sentences.en: He was only mischievous.

sentences.ar: وقلبه أطيب من قلب أي ولد.
sentences.en: And his heart was kinder than any boy's.

sentences.ar: وأم جو قالت: وجو كمان.
sentences.en: And Joe's mother said: and Joe too.

sentences.ar: ضربته على إشي ما عمله، والله يسامحني.
sentences.en: I beat him for something he did not do, God forgive me.

sentences.ar: وقالوا إنه الأحد رح يعملوا جنازة للتلاتة.
sentences.en: And they said that on Sunday they would hold a funeral for the three.

sentences.ar: لأنه بعد أربع أيام، ما حدا بيطلع من النهر.
sentences.en: Because after four days, no one comes out of the river.

sentences.ar: وتوم تحت السرير، وبده يطلع، وبده يعانق الخالة بولي.
sentences.en: And Tom under the bed, wanting to come out, wanting to hug Aunt Polly.

sentences.ar: بس ما طلع.
sentences.en: But he did not come out.

sentences.ar: لأنه إجت له فكرة أكبر.
sentences.en: Because a bigger idea had come to him.

sentences.ar: وراحوا الضيوف، ونامت الخالة، وهي بتصلي على توم.
sentences.en: And the guests left, and the aunt slept, praying over Tom.

sentences.ar: طلع توم من تحت السرير، ووقف جنبها.
sentences.en: Tom came out from under the bed, and stood beside her.

sentences.ar: كانت نايمة، ووجهها تعبان، وعلى خدها دمعة.
sentences.en: She was asleep, her face tired, a tear on her cheek.

sentences.ar: طلع قطعة القشرة من جيبه، وقرا اللي كتبه.
sentences.en: He took the piece of bark from his pocket, and read what he had written.

sentences.ar: إحنا مش ميتين، إحنا قراصنة.
sentences.en: We are not dead, we are pirates.

sentences.ar: وكان رح يحطها جنبها.
sentences.en: And he was about to put it beside her.

sentences.ar: بس فكر بالجنازة، وبالفكرة الكبيرة، ورجع القشرة لجيبه.
sentences.en: But he thought of the funeral, and the big idea, and put the bark back in his pocket.

sentences.ar: وباسها على خدها، وهي نايمة.
sentences.en: And he kissed her on the cheek, as she slept.

sentences.ar: وطلع، ورجع للنهر، وسبح للجزيرة قبل الفجر.
sentences.en: And he went out, went back to the river, and swam to the island before dawn.
